outcomes.reason: ["The registered text of Executive Order 8328 (the American Presidency Project capture) grants a further exemption for 'a period not in excess of six months from March 1, 1940' and states no ending date. Missing source: the Civil Service Commission or Department of Justice record fixing the period actually granted to Henry Clarke Hill, or a later order retiring or further exempting him, none of which is held; the packet's later-events search, name search and number-citation lookup found none."]
